items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: No, Hatchet is nobody. ... I'm interested in him. There was only one Hatchet in Memphis, as far as you know.

ctx.x: In Memphis in the 20s. It must have been him.
No, Hatchet is nobody. In Memphis in the 20s.

Yeah, that's what he played here in the 20s. That was a ball piano. Him and Willie Bloom was the... You stay here with Memphis Femme at the Grimer? You know what I'm saying? You didn't hear that? No. My name is Memphis Femme. Come in the Grimer. You know why he got that in Willie Bloom? He got that J. No Sola. He got two Js in the Old Sola. Every time I go down, he trying to get the help.
